BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transportation funding; adding a new section tochapter 46.16 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to all other license fees, passenger cars, traveltrailers, and motor homes are assessed a transportation improvement feeof one and onehalf cents per vehicle pound based on the empty scaleweight. In addition, vehicles licensed under RCW 46.16.070 weighingless than ten thousand pounds are assessed a transportation improvementfee of one and onehalf cents per pound based on the empty scaleweight. (2) The department of licensing shall collect the fee annually.The department will rely on the vehicle empty scale weights as providedby the manufacturers, or other sources defined by the department, todetermine the weight of each vehicle type. The department shall adoptrules to handle vehicles without manufacturer empty scale weights, suchas homebuilt vehicles. p. 1 HB 1871 (3) Twothirds of the revenue will be used by the state exclusivelyfor transportation purposes. Ninety percent of the state's share ofthe revenue must be deposited into the state's motor vehicle account tobe used for highway purposes. Ten percent of the revenue must bedeposited into the state's multimodal transportation account to be usedfor multimodal transportation capital purposes. The remainder will bedivided equally between counties and cities for transportation needsand distributed monthly by the state treasurer. A particular county'sdistribution will be based on the number of vehicles registered in thatcounty as a percentage of the state's total registrations, and aparticular city's distribution will be based on its population as apercentage of the state's total population living within incorporatedareas.
This act applies to vehicle registrationsdue or to become due on April 1, 2007, and thereafter.
